much poke damage and make sure you pick up the farm. E to dodge her charm if you need it, don’t be greedy and risk getting hit. Once you complete

One of Ekko’s hardest matchups. She has her W, E and passive movement speed to deny you from ever proccing your passive on her. Early on you want to avoid pushing at all costs,
stand on top of your caster minions if possible to make sure she pushes the wave if she tries to Q harass you. Akali’s Q costs 130 energy at rank 1, try to dance around the max range
of her Q, if you manage to bait it and dodge it you earn yourself a lot of free time. After the recent changes Akali is very very weak early on. It's very possible to win trades level 2-3 if you can bait out her W or E. She has very low base HP so you
do have kill threat. If you wanna trade with her you can jump on when she is inside a mi…

This is a free scaling matchup for Ekko, Anivia can only punish you the first 3 levels. Play the first levels slowly, but you can jump on her if she ever Qs the wave. Anivia quickly becomes hard to kill through her egg,
but at that point you should be around level 7 which allows you to ignore her by pushing and roaming. Ekko only needs to spend 80-90 mana to clear a wave while Anivia needs to spend a few hundred mana per wave.
Try meet the waves as far up in the lane as possible, preferably right outside of Anivia’s tower range, which forces her to choose between trying to poke you or saving her R and Q to clear the wave.
Don’t hesitate to dodge her Q with E. It’s super risky for Anivia to r…

A matchup that used to be super easy, but now after her E has been changed to give a ton of movement speed it’s actually pretty hard to punish her. Annie has a really long auto range
so play safe early and avoid taking too much auto poke damage. Annie has really weak waveclear, so as soon as you get 2 points into Q you can start pushing her in constantly.
Depending on how aggressive she is and how much hp you have, you can either start pushing level 3, or wait until level 4 when you can use W to zone and shield to absorb her poke while you shove the wave in.
Avoid trading unless she messes up, as long as she has her E up you can never proc passive and probably never land a W. Her E has a 15 …

Similarly to Annie, this matchup used to be super easy, but because of Asol’s mini rework it can be quite rough. If he holds his Q it’s basically impossible to ever get a passive proc onto him,
and he’ll kite you out with his W movement speed. However his damage is super low so he won’t be able to punish you very hard early on. Make sure to ping his potential roams,
and punish him if he ever wastes his Q and W to push the wave. Just like in a lot of other match ups, you’ll be able to jump on him even when he has Q and W up when you finish Proto,
as you’ll be able to use Protobelt to dash into him/behind him to dodge his Q and get a free passive proc. Use the passive movement speed to dodge a…

This is one of the commonly known good matchups for Ekko. One thing you can do is to go Hail of Blades and start E. This lets you dominate the lane from level 1, but it's easy to mess up if you are not used to HoB. Also HoB is nerfed and not as good anymore
Azir is really strong during the first levels of the match, being able to push hard and also harass if given the opportunity. Play smart early, let him push you until at least level 3-4 when you get 2 points into your Q. If you let him push the first waves,
you’ll be able to bounce the wave back into his tower for a free recall. If he bullies you too hard, you still have your tp which is fine to use. Azir is really strong during the first…

Don't let Brand poke you level 1, stay back and don't let him hit a W or get an E on you for free, at least make him work for it. You can look to trade already at level 2, if he has taken W at level 2 then you E forward as soon as he uses W and then
quick E Q auto and run. You want to trade in this matchup basically whenever he can't stun you, so if his Q is down you go, if his W and E are down you go. You can also go if he just wastes 1 ability. For example if he uses either E or W on the
wave then just insta W and E Q auto run trade. W might stun, but will no matter what absorb some of his damage. He is hyper immobile so landing W is very realistic. E away from his W if it's about to hit, …

This is the first matchup on the list where I recommend Ignite. In general you wanna take ignite vs champs that you have high kill potential against, champs that can’t really harass you early game, and champs that have a lot of healing.
Cassio heals quite a bit and she is killable. In season 10 Cassio used to struggle with mana, but this season a lot of Cassio players either start Tear or run Presence of Mind which gives her enough early game mana to harrass you a bit.
When you play with Ignite in a winning match up you do not want to auto push waves, you want to be smart about how you play with the wave.
You want the wave on your side of the lane, while permanently stopping the wave from ge…

This matchup is an easy outscale match up. Cho’Gath can’t really bully you early, and you can’t really bully him due to his passive giving him great sustain.
The only time you want to trade with him during the early game is when both the wave is pushing towards you and his Q is down.
The reason you don’t want to trade with him when the wave is pushing towards him, is that he’ll be able to farm safely close to/under his tower and he will heal up all the damage you dealt to him because of his passive.
Once you complete Protobelt you’ll have better trading potential even when his Q is up, as you can use Proto active to dodge it, but the Cho will probably be too tanky for you to deal significant…

Really easy matchup. Corki does super low damage early game so he shouldn’t be able to bully you. In this match up you want to let him push, and then start going for trades already from level 2.
You can win trades by just mindlessly jumping on him, but for optimal trades, don’t trade level 2 unless his E is down. Corki E does around 140 damage at rank 1 and also lowers your resistances quite a bit,
don’t underestimate this ability during the early levels. After level 3 you can keep jumping on him whenever your E is up, however if the Corki is good and doesn’t let you, push in the wave,
reset and after first base you automatically win until Corki has at least a fully completed item. You can p…

This matchup is hard but by playing it correctly you’ll be able to beat any Diana. Early game you wanna make sure you don’t push as she can run you down in a long lane. Let her push, if she ever uses W or Q to shove,
don’t hesitate to jump on her for a quick trade when the W shield expires. If she ever hits a Q on you, do not go in before the Q mark expires, or you will take A LOT of damage. If Diana isn’t fast enough to push,
try to freeze the wave right outside your tower because she has a hard time clearing minions close to your tower as you can zone her with W and she can’t get into range to auto ranged minions when they are close to your tower.

Free scaling lane. A good Karma will play super far up level 1 and go for a Mantra Q on you. Avoid poke at all costs, and avoid trading unless you’re getting a gank. It’s pointless to trade on her if she ever has W and E up. Karma deals decent

and hard shove the wave, then recall. If Karma has poked you too much and it’s risky to push, take W and farm safely, wait till level 4 when you have all abilities + 2 points in Q to easily shove the wave, …

you can easily land a W on him. You can play the early game in 2 different ways. If Kassadin tries to push, you let him, because he will never be able to crash the wave on you early game. Let him build up a wave, then freeze it close t…

This is a really easy match up if played correctly. You can start trading already at level 2 as long as Kata’s Q is down. Her Q will automatically push the wave, so you can use this to make sure you get the wave on your side of the lane. The only
way Kata ever kills you early in the lane is if the wave ends up on Kata’s side of the lane and then she runs you down with E, autos and Conqueror. If the enemy jungler deals AD damage, take armor instead of mr in runes, as Kata is heavily
auto attack based early. You can go for aggressive trades in this lane when: The wave is on your side of the lane and you can easily run back to your tower, when any one of Kata’s 3 basic abilities are on cooldown…

Super easy matchup. You can do whatever you want in this lane, you can push for prio and early roams or you can freeze and perma trade with her. Kayle’s W speed boost makes it hard to proc passive early game, but don’t be afraid to E Q
trade if you think the damage without the passive proc will be relevant. Her W has a relatively high mana cost, and also has a 15 second cooldown which means you’ll have a 5-6 seconds window to punish her after she uses it. Even though
Kayle is supposed to be weak early, you still need to have some respect. If you jump on her when her minion wave is too big, she can Q slow you and use her W to chase you. If you go for a trade when all her abilities are up, mak…

Kayn mid is not the most normal matchup, but eventually you might run into it. You will be spending the first levels under your turret because Kayn absolutely deletes minion waves early on. Let him push you in and avoid random trading
because he can easily push waves and recall to heal up without losing anything, and by trading you also give him progress towards his form. At around level 5, you start to become too strong for him to ignore you. During the first levels Kayn
can just spam Q on the wave to clear it, but after level 5 you can punish him by jumping on him if he goes for greedy Q pushes. Kayn mid players often roam a lot to try to get form progress, be on the lookout for his roams …

Fighting Kennen as Ekko is generally pretty easy. Early game you need to watch out for his auto poke, do your best to stay healthy because you wanna trade vs him every time he uses his E. Kennen’s E has a 10 second CD which
means it basically matches Ekko’s E CD. This means that you can only trade with Kennen after he has wasted it. Kennen has to use E eventually if he ever wants to match your Q waveclear. You’ll easily be able to push waves and go for
roams/recalls because Kennen can’t really poke you as long as you use minions as cover. Consider Merc Threads so you don’t get CC chained. As long as he doesn’t one shot you during his R, you will always end up on top after the trade.
When you…

Easy matchup as long as you play super safe early game. You don’t need to E to dodge his Q unless he stays in range to drag you, then E out before that happens. Kled should never be able to get the second part of his Q damage onto
you. If Kled uses E forward, quickly dash away with your E. If Kled’s E misses, then jump back onto him for a quick trade. If you manage to dismount him, run away and wait for your abilities to be up and he will be a free kill. Kled is incredibly
slow without his Skaarl which means you’ll get a free W hit on him. Use W in a way that makes it still hit him even if he uses his dismounted Q. It’s important that Kled doesn’t the second part of his Q on you, because it …

AP Kog’Maw has turned out pretty strong after his buffs, but luckily Ekko does super well into him. Be careful the first few levels, don’t let him run you down with Phase Rush and W. If he ever wastes W, go in on him as soon as the W ends, or
at least pressure him if he stays too far back. Don’t stand inside your minion wave so he doesn’t get to push the wave while poking you. Your push is stronger than Kog’s push from level 1-5, and then from level 7 onwards. After level 6 it will be
hard to punish Kog properly as he can just stand far back and farm safely. On cannon waves you can consider diving him with your jungler, but normally you just want to push and look for roams and pressure the m…

One of Ekko’s hardest matchups. Early game you need to stay far back, give up last hits, but try to stay in XP range. LeBlanc will look to auto, W, auto harass you, do everything you can to not let her, even if this means standing under your
tower level 1. It’s ok to walk up and get hit if you need to to stay in XP range. After level 2 you want to E to dodge her W. Her W CD is 18 seconds at rank 1, if you manage to dodge a W you buy yourself a lot of free time. However even if her W
is down you want to be careful about trading because her E, Q and autos will still hurt you a lot in the early game. Good LeBlanc players will push the first 2-3 waves, and then stop pushing to freeze the wave on…

Lee is not that broken anymore so just aim to survive lane with good cs mainly. Early game just sit back and relax, try to Q the first 3 melee minions from max range. Lee Sin's E level 1 with Doran's Blade start deals 119 DAMAGE. This is
extremely unbalanced so just stay out of his E range. Let him push to you no matter what. Do not fight him even if it seems juicy because he is tankier than a tank and deals more damage than an assassin. Just play to farm up the first levels.
The only way to kill Lee early is if your jungler comes. If your jungler pings that he is about go gank, or if you know in advance that your jungler will gank then you should trade, even if it's a bad trade because he w…

This matchup used to one of the harder ones, but Lissandra is pretty weak at the moment, especially early on. You basically get a free early game against her. Avoid standing behinds minions so she doesn't get to hit both the minions and
you with her Q. Avoid trading with her early on unless she wastes her W to clear the wave. When you trade with her and she has W up you most likely won't get to proc your passive on her, and even if you do, most Lissandra players go
Aftershock so your passive won't deal much damage. You will also end up taking a lot of return damage from her and her minions. Let her push the first 3-4 waves, then you can easily shove the wave when you have 2 points in Q.

Polymorph which will mess up your trade combo on her. Play the first levels slowly, avoid taking too much poke. When you get 2 points in Q you can farm relatively safely, and you should be able to push her in. If the Lulu is super aggressive
you can wait with your first recall before you start pushing. Your waveclear is a lot stronger than Lulu's, so you need to abuse it. Going for trades in lane is pretty pointless because she has so many tools to counter your …

really poke you. When you hit level 2 you don't want to jump on her unless she wastes both Q and E for some reason. Lux's Q CD is 11 seconds, so even if you trade with her and force her Q, it will basically be up again the next time you
combo her. Don't be afraid to use your E to dodge her E, and always use E to dodge her Q if it's about to hit you. Lux is a champ that you shouldn't be able to kill in the early game. Stunning her with a W is hard because …

Neeko will always be the one who 2 passive stacks on her. If the Neeko plays correctly (which is to play super aggressively) you will not be able to push her in early game. Play to survive, base around 750/785 gold …

Nocturne moves to, usually to know which side he wards. Respect Nocturne's absurd early power, especially level 2-3. E away from his fear if he goes aggressive. When playing Ekko it's really easy to set up ganks on Nocturne. As long as
you know which side he early wards, ping your jungler to come. Nocturne will always Q then walk up into the middle of the wave to clear it. Hide outside of vision and W on top of your wave. Nocturne has a spell shield, but it…

Be careful of her Q and auto poke level 1. Let her push you in. It is possible to trade with her in the early game, you have to look for a few openings. When you are level 2 you can trade with her if she wastes her Q. Without her Q, her W is
useless, and you will outtrade her hard. However don't go for trades if the wave is too big because minion damage can make you lose the trade. Later on in the lane you can still jump on her if she misses Q, but she can shield herself then
W to run away and then chase you down with Phase Rush. The optimal time to trade is when her E is down, and even better if her E is down and she uses Q. However, good Ori players will not give you many openings early on…

Some time you might run into an Ornn mid. Maybe a top laner that's offrole or just someone who wants to play some Ornn mid. This matchup is really easy and simple. Take Conqueror to outscale him easily, but you can also beat him early on.
Make sure he doesn't poke you for free level 1. Never let him W + auto you. Level 2 you can already start trading. What you can do is walk up to him, Q, auto, and when Ornn uses W, E sideways and then blink onto him. E away from his E if
it's about to knock you up. When you fight Ornn after level 6, don't move around too much. Try to position your R on top of yourself so you can dodge his R while also hitting him if you start fighting. Ornn does become extr…

Trading early on vs Pyke is risky and not really worth it because of his passive healing. Be careful early game, especially level 1 and 2. Pyke can do surprising amounts of damage with his E flash combo and auto attacks early. Don't be greedy to
dodge his Q with your E. If Pyke uses E forward, dodge it by using E sideways. After level 4 you can easily start pushing the waves, and Pyke really struggles to match your Q spam waveclear. You're always going to be stronger than the Pyke
1v1. Make sure you ping out his potential roams so he doesn't get fed because that's the only way he can beat you. Focus on farming and you're always going to be stronger than Pyke.
